parsed_response.concise_technical_rationale: Node 1 was reviewed across its full boundary against all source-study elements and guidewords [SYS-01 to SYS-08]. The boundary covers the inlet, the V-001 three-phase FWKO, the gas outlet to fuel gas and burn pit, the oil outlet to the Heater–Treater, the water outlet to water treatment, E-001, and the relief and shutdown valves. Prioritisation reflects severity and gaps in identifiable safeguards rather than any single scenario. Overpressure ranks first: PV-101 and PSV-101 A/B are listed, but set pressure, capacity and the 60 versus 125 psig basis are unverified. Loss of level with gas blowby, and high level with liquid carryover to fuel gas and the burn pit, rank next because no level measurement or independent level trips are listed. The next tier comprises internal corrosion in water-wetted zones, the source-supported start-up-without-bypass error, external fire, and instrument/line-up error. Instrument roles are inferred from tag conventions only. Organizational factors are not assessed for lack of evidence [SYS-09]. Risk classes are qualitative and for prioritisation only.
